Recommended

A short guide that tells your AI agent when to use OfficeKit instead of reading large files itself. It costs about 80 tokens until it is used. Pick the agents you use.

Checking…

An agent that is not on this Mac is skipped. A skill with another author is never overwritten.

Connect through MCP

For apps without skills, or for tasks with many calls. Adds about 770 tokens of tool descriptions per session. Copy the setting for your app, paste it once, then restart that app.

Privacy: OfficeKit works offline, but what an agent receives back (extracted text, numbers, file names) goes to that agent's AI provider under their terms. A password you ask an agent to use is visible to it too. Clipboard history, snippets, dictation and transcripts are never shared with agents.

          Automations
          Choose when work starts and where OfficeKit can read files.
          
                
          Saved pipelines
          Available
          Save local recipes and run them on selected files. Every pipeline starts paused; automatic triggers are not enabled.
          Files are processed on this device. Original files are preserved.
          
                
          Clipboard monitoring
          Available · opt-in
          When enabled, changed clipboard images are optimized locally with metadata removed. Clipboard text is ignored and the original image stays unchanged.
          Monitoring is off. Clipboard contents are not read.
          
                
          Watched folders
          Native grant · session only
          Choose a saved pipeline, then grant one folder. New stable files run locally and create a uniquely named prepared copy beside the source. Pause a grant at any time; remove it to stop watching and release folder access.
          Folder access is off until you grant a folder. Grants end when OfficeKit closes.
            
                
            Preset zones
            Local · off by default
            Bind a named drop target to a saved pipeline. Enablement lasts for this session. Dropped files run locally and produce a separate copy to review and save; use “Use preset” to load the pipeline for a manual batch.
            All zones start off. Enable one for this session to register its drop target.
              
                
              Clipboard hotkey and Finder action
              Hotkey · opt-in
              Press Control+Shift+C to optimize the current clipboard image locally and place the prepared image on the clipboard. Clipboard text is ignored. This runs only after you enable the shortcut.
              Shortcut is off. Clipboard contents are not read.
              Finder Quick Action
              Install “Optimize Image with OfficeKit” to prepare selected images locally. OfficeKit saves a numbered copy beside each original.
              Quick Action status is being checked.
              
                
              Command line and MCP
              CLI and MCP available
              The app bundle includes the local Media Toolkit CLI and an MCP stdio server at OfficeKit.app/Contents/Resources/binaries/officekit-media. Configure an MCP client to launch that executable with --mcp-server. Both use the same allowlisted operations, process locally, and refuse to replace existing outputs.
              
                
              Output naming
              Separate copy
              Prepared files get a sibling-style suggested name. OfficeKit opens a native save dialog; replacing an existing destination requires the dialog’s explicit overwrite confirmation.
              Suggested namephoto.webp → photo_prepared.webp
              
                
              Upload and file shelf
              Unavailable
              Cloud upload and a persistent prepared-file shelf are not connected. Prepared copies remain available here for up to 30 minutes or until the app closes; save them before then.
              
              
              Search local settings and defaults
              Search all operations and apply their built-in or saved settings. Saved defaults stay on this device and are shared with MCP; only operation values are stored.
                Saved pipelines
                Build a local recipe from available steps. New recipes start paused and run only when you select files and press Prepare.
                Optional. Use {name}, {media}, and {ext}. Keep {name} and finish with {ext}; OfficeKit adds a number if the name already exists. Files are always saved as new copies.

                    No preparation run in this session yet. Results appear after you prepare files.

                    What this removesEXIF fields such as camera details, capture time and GPS coordinates.
                    
                      JPEG orientation and image quality are preserved. Animated GIF/WebP frames and TIFF pages stay intact. Other identifying metadata may remain.
                      
                
                      
                
                      
                    
                    
                    
                
                      
                
                      No account or network connection required. Image content is not saved in History.
                      
            
                      

            
                      
                
                       Processed locally
                      
                
                      Resize images
                      
                
                      Set maximum dimensions. OfficeKit preserves proportions and never enlarges smaller images.
                      
                
                
                      
                    
                    
                
                      
                
                      How sizing worksImages that exceed either bound shrink to fit. Aspect ratio and orientation are preserved; smaller images stay their original size.
                      Animated GIF/WebP frames and TIFF pages stay intact when supported. No RAW or HEIC resizing is claimed.
                      
                
                      Your originals remain unchanged. Image contents are not added to History.
                      
            
                      

            
                      
                
                       Processed locally
                      
                
                      URL encode / decode
                      
                
                      Prepare text for a URL or read URL-encoded text. Input stays on this computer and is not saved to History.
                      
                
                      
                    
                    
                
                      
                
                
                
                      0 / 1,048,576 characters · 0 / 1 MiB UTF-8
                      
                
                      
                    
                    
                    
                
                      
                
                
                
                      
                
                      OfficeKit encodes a URI component: reserved characters, spaces and slashes are escaped. Decoding rejects malformed percent escapes and invalid UTF-8.
                      
            
                      

            
                      
                
                       Local utility
                      
                
                      Developer utilities
                      
                
                      Format structured data, encode Base64, inspect a JWT, or calculate text hashes. Input and results stay out of History, Favorites, bookmarks and telemetry.
                      
                
                
                
                      
                
                      
                
                
                      
                
                
                      
                
                      Maximum input: 1 MiB UTF-8. Content is not saved or sent to a remote service.
                      
                
                      
                
                
                      JWT inspection only decodes header and claims; it does not verify signatures or trust the token. HMAC keys and pasted content are transient and are never saved.

                      Scientific calculator
                      
                    
                    
                    
                    
                    
                    
                      
                    
                      Supports bounded arithmetic, constants and approved functions. Calculations run on this device; unsupported expressions show an input error.
                      
                
                      

                
                      
                    
                      Unit converter
                      
                    
                    
                    
                      
                        
                        
                        
                    
                      
                    
                      
                    
                      
                        
                        
                    
                      
                    
                    
                      
                    
                      Unit definitions are loaded from the local conversion engine.
                      
                
                      

                
                      
                    
                      Margin & markup
                      
                    
                      Enter cost and revenue in the same currency. Money rounds half-up to cents; percentages use entered values. Margin uses revenue as its denominator; markup uses cost.
                      
                    
                      
                        
                        
                    
                      
                    
                    
                      
                    
                      Negative profit is allowed when revenue is below cost. A zero denominator produces “undefined”, not a fabricated percentage. Taxes, fees and currency conversion are excluded.
                      
                
                      

                
                      
                    
                      Break-even point
                      
                    
                      Required units are rounded up to the next whole unit so revenue covers fixed costs.
                      
                    
                      
                        
                        
                        
                    
                      
                    
                    
                      
                    
                      Price must exceed variable cost. This simplified model excludes tax, fees, discounts, multiple products and other variable costs.
                      
                
                      

                
                      
                    
                      Simple interest
                      
                    
                      Enter a nominal annual rate and an explicit duration. Amounts remain in your chosen currency.
                      
                    
                      
                        
                        
                        
                        
                    
                      
                    
                    
                      
                    
                      No compounding, fees, tax, day-count convention or irregular-period handling. Results use half-up rounding to two decimal places.
                      
                
                      

                
                      
                    
                      Straight-line depreciation
                      
                    
                      Create an annual schedule that reconciles to the asset's salvage value.
                      
                    
                      
                        
                        
                        
                    
                      
                    
                    
                      
                    
                      Straight-line only. The final period adjusts for cent rounding. Dates, partial years, declining-balance methods, tax treatment and currency conversion are excluded.
                      
                
                      

                
                      
                    
                      Everyday percentages
                      
                    
                      Work out a percentage, compare a change, or find discount savings. Values are unit-neutral; OfficeKit does not infer currency or taxes.
                      
                    
                    
                      
                        
                        
                    
                      
                    
                      
                        
                        
                    
                      
                    
                      
                        
                        
                    
                      
                    
                    
                      
                    
                      Results round half-up to two decimal places. Percentage change requires a non-zero original value. Taxes, currency and jurisdiction are not inferred.
                      
                
                      
                
                      
                    
                      Net gain and return on investment for one purchase or project. Fees are added to the cost. This is not annualised; use Growth rate (CAGR) for a yearly rate.
                      
                    
                      
                    
                    
                      
                
                      
                
                      
                    
                      Compound annual growth rate from a start value, an end value and the number of years (decimals allowed).
                      
                    
                      
                    
                    
                      
                
                      
                
                      
                    
                      Paste one value per line or separate them with commas. A blank line counts as a missing value. Weights are optional and must match the number of values.
                      
                    
                      
                    
                      
                        
                        
                        
                    
                      
                    
                
                      
                
                      
                    
                      Exact fractions with whole-number numerators and denominators. Results simplify and show a mixed number and a decimal.
                      
                    
                      
                    
                    
                      
                
                      
                
                      
                    
                      Two to one hundred whole numbers, separated by commas or new lines. Zero is allowed; a list containing zero has an LCM of zero.
                      
                    
                    
                    
                      
                
                      
                
                      
                    
                      Mean, median, mode, range, variance and standard deviation. Choose sample for a subset of a larger group, population for the whole group.

                      Calendar dates only; no time of day or time zone.
                      
                    
                      
                    
                    
                    
                      
                
                      
                
                      
                    
                      Exact age on a chosen date in years, months and days, plus the next birthday. The default date is today on this Mac.
                      
                    
                      
                    
                    
                      
                
                      
                
                      
                    
                      Working days between two dates, excluding the weekend you choose and any holidays you list (one YYYY-MM-DD date per line).
                      
                    
                      
                    
                    
                      Weekend and holidays
                      
                    
                    
                      
                
                      
                
                      
                    
                      One shift per line: date start end break-minutes, for example 2026-03-02 09:00 17:30 30. Times use 24-hour HH:MM. An end time before the start time is an overnight shift.
                      
                    
                      
                    
                    
                
                      
                
                      
                    
                      Convert a local date and time to other zones. Daylight-saving rules for that date are applied. Zones use IANA names such as Europe/London.
                      
                    
                      Which 01:30

All dimensions use the one unit you pick.

                        Smart dictation
                        Cleaner text without leaving your Mac. Nothing you say or type is sent anywhere or written to logs.
                        
                        Runs on this Mac
                    
                        
                    
                        
                        
                        
                            
                        Smart cleanup
                        Removes “um” and false starts, applies corrections (“at 3, no, 4” becomes “at 4”) and fixes punctuation. Never adds new content. Your text is pasted even if cleanup fails. English only.
                        
                            
                        
                        
                        
                        
                            
                        Fix grammar
                        Fixes clear mistakes such as “we was” → “we were” and “a apple” → “an apple” before pasting. Names, jargon, spelling and anything in your dictionary are left alone. Works offline on every Mac, and “How it was made” shows what changed.
                        
                            
                        
                        
                        
                        
                            
                        Use the app you are typing in
                        Uses the app name (for example Slack or Mail) to pick vocabulary. Password fields are never used.
                        
                            
                        
                        
                        
                        
                            
                        
                                
                        Use text around the cursor Off
                        Lets on-device cleanup read a short piece of the text already in the field to spell names correctly. It has no effect until on-device cleanup is available. Off by default. The text is used for this dictation only and is not stored.
                        
                                
                            
                        
                            
                        Needs Accessibility access, which dictation already uses. Password fields are always skipped.
                        
                        
                        
                        
                        
                            
                        Faster results
                        Finalizes completed phrases while you are still speaking, so pasting is quicker after you release the key. Turn off if words go missing after pauses.
